Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir:

If Ireland wants to preach morality to us so much and wants to help the Gazans, then let them take them in from Gaza. https://t.co/w8MGykxx2A

Host: Why would anyone take Palestinians in?

Ben-Gvir: For money. In exchange for money. It would cost us a lot, but in the end, it saves us money in the defense budget.

Host: But they’ll say we’re selling Palestinians. https://t.co/2tB4CgWsq6

Host: If there are no Palestinians in Gaza, there will be peace.

Ben-Gvir: Period. And we need to want that. I’m not sure everyone on our side wanted it. Bibi didn’t want it.

We had concrete offers, and he didn’t take them. https://t.co/hFu1zImIn0
